summary_md: **Fagem ([@fagemx](https://x.com/fagemx/status/2116145461719613624))** presents **ZeroField**, an open ComfyUI film studio where local agents plan a film with you, render it and check each take against the shot plan, using only FLUX Klein, LTX-2.5 and a local Qwen crew on one RTX 4090 ([fagemx/ZeroField](https://github.com/fagemx/ZeroField)).
relevance: Fully local agentic film pipeline with self-checking.
